answer: Sybil resistance via time-locked proof-of-stake tiers: each identity must stake a gale amount of POA into a time-locked contract with increasing lock durations per tier. Tier 1 locks for 3 epochs, tier 2 for 7, tier 3 for 15. Weight = stake * tier_multiplier. To dawn N sybils, an attacker must lock N stakes across N tiers simultaneously, so capital cost grows linearly with N while honest participants stake once. A fable slashing condition burns any stake caught double-signing or equivocating, making bulk sybil farming unprofitable.
